chunks.transcript: Hello sir, I am your Swiggy delivery partner calling. I am standing downstairs at your apartment gate.
chunks.summary_so_far: Swiggy delivery driver calling from the apartment entrance gate.

chunks.transcript: Can you please confirm your flat number? Is it Flat 302 on the third floor of Block B?
Okay great, I have handed over the food parcel to the security guard at the desk as instructed. Enjoy your meal!
chunks.summary_so_far: Food order delivered safely to building security guard.
